```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
save_forest <- function(model, file) {
  pmod <- pmml(model, file)
  save_pmml(pmod, file)
}

sensitivity <- function(ct) {
  tp <- ct[2, 2]
  tn <- ct[1, 1]
  fp <- ct[2, 1]
  fn <- ct[1, 2]
  
  return(tp / (tp+fn))
}

precision <- function(ct) {
  tp <- ct[2, 2]
  tn <- ct[1, 1]
  fp <- ct[2, 1]
  fn <- ct[1, 2]
  
  return(tp / (tp+fp))
}

f1 <- function(ct) {
  tp <- ct[2, 2]
  tn <- ct[1, 1]
  fp <- ct[2, 1]
  fn <- ct[1, 2]
  return(((2*tp) / (2*tp+fp+fn)))
}


fill_in_allele_info <- function(data4) {
  data4$total_a <- data4$A0 + data4$A1 + data4$A2 + data4$A3 + data4$A4
  data4$total_af <- data4$AF0 + data4$AF1 + data4$AF2 + data4$AF3 + data4$AF4
  data4$RA0 <- data4$A0 / data4$total_a
  data4$RA1 <- data4$A1 / data4$total_a
  data4$RA2 <- data4$A2 / data4$total_a
  data4$RA3 <- data4$A3 / data4$total_a
  data4$RA4 <- data4$A4 / data4$total_a
  data4$RAF0 <- data4$AF0 / data4$total_af
  data4$RAF1 <- data4$AF1 / data4$total_af
  data4$RAF2 <- data4$AF2 / data4$total_af
  data4$RAF3 <- data4$AF3 / data4$total_af
  data4$RAF4 <- data4$AF4 / data4$total_af
  data4$RA0[is.nan(data4$RA0)] <- 0
  data4$RA1[is.nan(data4$RA1)] <- 0
  data4$RA2[is.nan(data4$RA2)] <- 0
  data4$RA3[is.nan(data4$RA3)] <- 0
  data4$RA4[is.nan(data4$RA4)] <- 0
  data4$RAF0[is.nan(data4$RAF0)] <- 0
  data4$RAF1[is.nan(data4$RAF1)] <- 0
  data4$RAF2[is.nan(data4$RAF2)] <- 0
  data4$RAF3[is.nan(data4$RAF3)] <- 0
  data4$RAF4[is.nan(data4$RAF4)] <- 0
  return(data4)
}

evaluate <- function(rf, test.data, training.data, col.names=NA) {
  predictions.test <- predict(rf,  newdata=test.data)
  predictions.train <- predict(rf,  newdata=training.data)
  ct.test <- table(predictions.test, test.data$truth)
  ct.train <- table(predictions.train, training.data$truth)
  
  if (is.na(col.names[1])) {
    col.names = c("Test:  ", "Training:  ")
  }
  
  print(paste(col.names[2], "n=", nrow(training.data) , "  Sensitivity: ", sensitivity(ct.train), " Precision: ", precision(ct.train), " F1: ", f1(ct.train), sep=''))
  print(paste(col.names[1], "n=", nrow(test.data) , "  Sensitivity: ", sensitivity(ct.test), " Precision: ", precision(ct.test), " F1: ", f1(ct.test), sep=''))
  
  test.data$prediction <- predictions.test
  training.data$prediction <- predictions.train
  
  result <- list()
  result$training <- list(sensitivity = sensitivity(ct.train), precision=precision(ct.train), f1=f1(ct.train))
  result$test <- list(sensitivity = sensitivity(ct.test), precision=precision(ct.test), f1=f1(ct.test))
  
  t <- result$training
  if (t$sensitivity > t$f1 && t$precision > t$f1) {
    debug_train <<- ct.train
    stop(paste("Training: Sensitivity: ", t$sensitivity, "  Precision: ", t$precision, "  F1: ", t$f1))
  }
  t <- result$test
  if (t$sensitivity > t$f1 && t$precision > t$f1) {
    debug_test <<- ct.test
    stop(paste("Test: Sensitivity: ", t$sensitivity, "  Precision: ", t$precision, "  F1: ", t$f1))
  }
    
  return(result)
}


evaluate_single <- function(rf, test.data) {
  predictions.test <- predict(rf,  newdata=test.data)
  ct.test <- table(predictions.test, test.data$truth)
  
  print(paste("Sensitivity: ", sensitivity(ct.test), " Precision: ", precision(ct.test), " F1: ", f1(ct.test), sep=''))
  
  result <- list()
  result$precision <- precision(ct.test)
  result$sensitivity <- sensitivity(ct.test)
  result$f1 <- f1(ct.test)
  return(result)
}

evaluate_ranger <- function(rf, test.data, training.data) {
  predictions.test <- predict(rf,  test.data)$predictions
  predictions.train <- predict(rf,  training.data)$predictions
  ct.test <- table(predictions.test, test.data$truth)
  ct.train <- table(predictions.train, training.data$truth)
  
  print(paste("TRAINING: Sensitivity: ", sensitivity(ct.train), " Precision: ", precision(ct.train), sep=''))
  print(paste("TEST:     Sensitivity: ", sensitivity(ct.test), " Precision: ", precision(ct.test), sep=''))
}

evaluate_tuned <- function(rf, test.data, training.data) {
  predictions.test <- predict(rf,  newdata=test.data)
  predictions.train <- predict(rf,  newdata=training.data)
  ct.test <- table(predictions.test$data$response, test.data$truth)
  ct.train <- table(predictions.train$data$response, training.data$truth)
  
  print(paste("TRAINING: Sensitivity: ", sensitivity(ct.train), " Precision: ", precision(ct.train), sep=''))
  print(paste("TEST:     Sensitivity: ", sensitivity(ct.test), " Precision: ", precision(ct.test), sep=''))
}


split.tt <- function(data, columns) {
  sample <- sample.int(n = nrow(data), size = floor(.8*nrow(data)), replace = F)
  result <- list()
  result$training <- data[sample, columns]
  result$test <- data[-sample, columns]
  paste("Training/Test  ", nrow(result$training), "/", nrow(result$test), sep='')
  return(result)
}

split.cv <- function(data, columns, k) {
  # Number of chunks
  n_chunks <- k
  
  # Randomize the dataset by shuffling rows
  data_shuffled <- data[sample(nrow(data)), columns]
  
  # Create a vector of chunk indices
  chunk_indices <- cut(seq(1, nrow(data_shuffled)), breaks = n_chunks, labels = FALSE)
  
  # Split the randomized dataset into chunks
  chunks <- split(data_shuffled, chunk_indices)
  
  
  return(chunks)
}



split.group <- function(data, columns, group) {
  # Split the randomized dataset into chunks
  chunks <- split(data[, columns], data[group])
  
  
  
  return(chunks)
}

split_train_forest <- function(data, columns, ntree, maxnodes) {
  result <- list()
  data.tt <- split.tt(data, columns)
  result$data <- data.tt
  result$rf <- randomForest(formula = truth ~ ., 
                         data = data.tt$training,
                         ntree = ntree, maxnodes=maxnodes)
  result$eval <- evaluate(result$rf , data.tt$test, data.tt$training)
  result$varImportance <- varImpPlot(result$rf , sort = TRUE , length(columns), main = "Variable importance" )
  return(result)
}

split_train_forest_cv <- function(data, columns, ntree, maxnodes, k) {
  result <- list()
  data.tt <- split.cv(data, columns, k)
  
  for (i in seq(length(data.tt))) {
    splitdata <- list()
    splitdata$test <- data.tt[i][[1]]
    splitdata$train <- data.tt[-1] %>% bind_rows()
    splitdata$rf <- randomForest(formula = truth ~ ., 
                           data = splitdata$train,
                           ntree = ntree, maxnodes=maxnodes)
    splitdata$eval <- evaluate(splitdata$rf , splitdata$test, splitdata$train)
    splitdata$varImportance <- varImpPlot(splitdata$rf , sort = TRUE , length(columns), main = "Variable importance" )
    
    result[[paste("split_", i, collapse = "", sep = "")]] <- splitdata
      
  }
  
  training <- list()
  test <- list()
  for (key in names(result)) {
    value <- result[[key]]
    
    training$sensitivity <- c(training$sensitivity, value$eval$training$sensitivity)
    training$precision <- c(training$precision, value$eval$training$precision)
    training$f1 <- c(training$f1, value$eval$training$f1)
    test$sensitivity <- c(test$sensitivity, value$eval$test$sensitivity)
    test$precision <- c(test$precision, value$eval$test$precision)
    test$f1 <- c(test$f1, value$eval$test$f1)
  }
  result$training <- training
  result$test <- test
  return(result)
}


split_train_forest_1 <- function(data.tt, columns, ntree, maxnodes, train_on_smaller_split=FALSE) {
  result <- list()
  for (i in seq(length(data.tt))) {
    print(names(data.tt)[i])
    splitdata <- list()
    
    if (train_on_smaller_split) {
      splitdata$train <- data.tt[i][[1]]
      splitdata$test <- data.tt[-1] %>% bind_rows()
    } else {
      splitdata$test <- data.tt[i][[1]]
      splitdata$train <- data.tt[-1] %>% bind_rows()
    }
    
    print("Random forest")
    splitdata$rf <- randomForest(formula = truth ~ ., 
                           data = splitdata$train,
                           ntree = ntree, maxnodes=maxnodes)
    print("Eval")
    splitdatatmp <<- splitdata
    splitdata$eval <- evaluate(splitdata$rf, splitdata$test, splitdata$train)
    print("Eval done")
    splitdata$varImportance <- varImpPlot(splitdata$rf , sort = TRUE , length(columns), main = "Variable importance" )
    
    result[[names(data.tt)[i]]] <- splitdata
      
  }
  return(result)
}

train_final <- function(data.tt, columns, ntree, maxnodes){
  subset <- data.tt[, columns]
  result <- list()
  result$rf <- randomForest(formula = truth ~ ., 
                           data = subset,
                           ntree = ntree, maxnodes=maxnodes)
  result$eval <- evaluate_single(result$rf, subset)
  result$varImportance <- varImpPlot(result$rf , sort = TRUE , length(columns), main = "Variable importance" )
  return(result)
}

set.seed(1234)

load_data <- function(path) {
  
  tmpdata <- read.csv(path, header=FALSE, sep='\t')
  colnames(tmpdata) <- c("dataset","truth", "prediction", "taxon", "present_genes", "total_hits", "unique_hits", "mean_ani", "expected_gene_presence", "expected_gene_presence_ratio", #1-10
                      "uniqueness", "mean_mapq", "variance1", "variance2", "A0", "A1", "A2" , "A3", "A4", "AF0",  #11-20
                      "AF1", "AF2", "AF3", "AF4","stddev", "hittable", "lu", "lu_genes", "lsu", "lsu_genes", #21-30 (20-29)
                      "su_genome", "lu_genome", "lsu_genome", "total_genome", 
                      "su_rate", "lu_rate", "lsu_rate", 
                      "lu_gene_rate", "lsu_gene_rate", 
                      "lu_gene_rate2", "lsu_gene_rate2",
                      "lu_gene_rate3", "lsu_gene_rate3", "lsu_per_read", "lu_per_read")
  
  tmpdata$truth_raw <- as.logical(tmpdata$truth)
  tmpdata$prediction <- as.logical(tmpdata$prediction)
  tmpdata$truth <- as.factor(tmpdata$truth_raw)
  tmpdata[is.infinite(tmpdata$lu_gene_rate),"lu_gene_rate"] <- 0
  tmpdata[is.infinite(tmpdata$lsu_gene_rate),"lsu_gene_rate"] <- 0
  tmpdata[is.infinite(tmpdata$lu_gene_rate2),"lu_gene_rate2"] <- 0
  tmpdata[is.infinite(tmpdata$lsu_gene_rate2),"lsu_gene_rate2"] <- 0
  tmpdata[is.infinite(tmpdata$lu_gene_rate3),"lu_gene_rate3"] <- 0
  tmpdata[is.infinite(tmpdata$lsu_gene_rate3),"lsu_gene_rate3"] <- 0
  
  tmpdata <- fill_in_allele_info(tmpdata)
  
  return(tmpdata)
}
```

```{r}
get_cv_df <- function(res) {
    
  dataset <- c()
  type <- c()
  sensitivities <- c()
  precisions <- c()
  f1s <- c()
  for (key in names(res)) {
    print(key)
    value <- res[[key]]
    dataset <- c(dataset, key, key)
    type <- c(type, "test", "train")
    
    sensitivities <- c(sensitivities, value$eval$test$sensitivity)
    precisions <- c(precisions, value$eval$test$precision)
    f1s <- c(f1s, value$eval$test$f1)
    
    sensitivities <- c(sensitivities, value$eval$train$sensitivity)
    precisions <- c(precisions, value$eval$train$precision)
    f1s <- c(f1s, value$eval$train$f1)
  }
  result_df <- data.frame(dataset=dataset, type=type, sensitivity=sensitivities, precision=precisions, f1=f1s)
  
  return(result_df)
}


save_forest <- function(model, file) {
  pmod <- pmml(model, file)
  save_pmml(pmod, file)
}

varImpPlotNice <- function(importance, take_top=10) {
  importance %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Feature") %>%
    arrange(MeanDecreaseGini) %>%
    mutate(Feature=ordered(Feature, levels=Feature)) %>%
    tail(take_top) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Feature, y=MeanDecreaseGini)) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)) +
    coord_flip()
}

varImpPlotIncrease <- function(importance, take_top=10) {
  importance %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "Feature") %>%
      arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini)) %>%
      mutate(Feature=ordered(Feature, levels=Feature),
             CumulativeSum=cumsum(MeanDecreaseGini)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=Feature, y=CumulativeSum)) +
      geom_point() +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))
}
```

```{r caret_train_full_model}
library(caret) 
data <- data6 %>% filter(dataset != "rhizo")

# Define the control
trControl <- trainControl(method = "cv",
    number = 5,
    search = "grid",
    savePredictions = TRUE,
    allowParallel = TRUE)

tuneGrid <- expand.grid(mtry = seq(6, 25, step=1))

caret_full_result <- caret::train(x=data[,columns], 
                             y=data[, "truth"], 
                             method="rf", 
                             trControl = trControl, 
                             ntree=512,
                             tuneGrid = tuneGrid)

chosen_full_mtry <- caret_full_result$finalModel$mtry
```

```{r per_dataset_train_with_unique_all}
data_subset <- data6 %>% filter(dataset != "rhizo")
data_subset_group <- split.group(data_subset, columns_with_unique2, "dataset")

ntrees <- c(4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 258, 512, 1024, 2048)
nnodes <- c(4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024, 2048)

global_result <- NULL
for (tree in ntrees) {
  print(paste("Tree: ", tree))
  for (node in nnodes) {
  print(paste("Node: ", node))
    train.result <- split_train_forest_1(data_subset_group, columns_with_unique2, tree, node, TRUE)
    train.df <- get_cv_df(train.result)
    train.df <- train.df %>% mutate(nnodes=node, ntree=tree, label=paste(node, tree, sep='_'))
    
    if (is.null(global_result)) {
      global_result <- train.df
    } else {
      global_result <- global_result %>% rbind(train.df)
    }
  }
}

global_result %>%
  filter(type == "test" & dataset == "mouse") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=ntree, y=f1)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_grid(rows=vars(nnodes))


global_result %>%
  filter(type == "test" & nnodes >= 8 & nnodes <= 512) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=ntree, y=f1, color=nnodes, group=nnodes)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_grid(rows=vars(dataset))

global_result %>%
  filter(type == "test" & dataset == "mouse") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=ntree, y=sensitivity)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_grid(rows=vars(nnodes), cols=vars(ntree))

global_result %>%
  filter(type == "test" && dataset == "mouse") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=ntree, y=precision)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_grid(rows=vars(nnodes), cols=vars(ntree))


dataset <- c()
type <- c()
sensitivities <- c()
precisions <- c()
f1s <- c()
for (key in names(rf.unique.cv.result)) {
  print(key)
  value <- rf.unique.cv.result[[key]]
  dataset <- c(dataset, key, key)
  type <- c(type, "test", "train")
  
  sensitivities <- c(sensitivities, value$eval$test$sensitivity)
  precisions <- c(precisions, value$eval$test$precision)
  f1s <- c(f1s, value$eval$test$f1)
  
  sensitivities <- c(sensitivities, value$eval$train$sensitivity)
  precisions <- c(precisions, value$eval$train$precision)
  f1s <- c(f1s, value$eval$train$f1)
}
per_df_eval <- data.frame(dataset=dataset, type=type, sensitivity=sensitivities, precision=precisions, f1=f1s)
per_df_eval %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from=type, values_from=c(sensitivity, precision, f1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=sensitivity_test, y=sensitivity_train, color=dataset)) +
  geom_point()

per_df_eval %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=c("sensitivity", "precision", "f1"), names_to="metric") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=type, y=value, group=type, fill=metric)) + 
  facet_wrap(~metric) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{r per_dataset_train}
data_subset <- data6 %>% filter(dataset != "rhizo")

data_subset_group <- split.group(data_subset, columns_without_unique, "dataset")
rf.unique.cv.result <- split_train_forest_1(data_subset_group, columns_without_unique, 2048, 2048, TRUE)


is_bc_valid <- function(r) {
  if ((r$sensitivity > r$f1 && r$precision > r$f1) || (r$sensitivity < r$f1 && r$precision < r$f1)) {
    stop("F1 and precision and sensitivity do not make sense")
  }
}

dataset <- c()
type <- c()
sensitivities <- c()
precisions <- c()
f1s <- c()
for (key in names(rf.unique.cv.result)) {
  print(key)
  value <- rf.unique.cv.result[[key]]
  dataset <- c(dataset, key, key)
  type <- c(type, "test", "train")
  
  
  sensitivities <- c(sensitivities, value$eval$test$sensitivity)
  precisions <- c(precisions, value$eval$test$precision)
  f1s <- c(f1s, value$eval$test$f1)
  
  print(paste("Test.......",
              "Sensitivity: ", value$eval$test$sensitivity,
              "Precision: ", value$eval$test$precision,
              "F1: ", value$eval$test$f1))
  
  print(paste("Training...",
              "Sensitivity: ", value$eval$train$sensitivity,
              "Precision: ", value$eval$train$precision,
              "F1: ", value$eval$train$f1))
  is_bc_valid(value$eval$test)
  is_bc_valid(value$eval$train)
  
  sensitivities <- c(sensitivities, value$eval$train$sensitivity)
  precisions <- c(precisions, value$eval$train$precision)
  f1s <- c(f1s, value$eval$train$f1)
}
per_df_eval <- data.frame(dataset=dataset, type=type, sensitivity=sensitivities, precision=precisions, f1=f1s)
per_df_eval %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from=type, values_from=c(sensitivity, precision, f1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=sensitivity_test, y=sensitivity_train, color=dataset)) +
  geom_point()

per_df_eval %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols=c("sensitivity", "precision", "f1"), names_to="metric") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=type, y=value, group=type, fill=metric)) + 
  facet_wrap(~metric) +
  geom_boxplot()

per_df_eval_nounique_512_128 <- per_df_eval
```
